capabilities: Browse a folder's notes chronologically with content previews
Filter the list by tag, day, month, and full-text search
Show a six-month activity heatmap of note creation
Check off open tasks grouped by their tags
Create dated new notes from an optional template
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that shows a folder's notes as a date-ordered feed with activity and tag-based filtering, which journal and log keeping depends on.
summary: Folder timeline view that lists a folder's notes chronologically with an activity heatmap, tag browser, search, date filters, and open-task checking.
